  if (params.has('agent')) import('../agent/agentBridge.js').then((m) => m.installAgentBridge({ cam, heightAt, outdoorWaterAt: (x, z) => { const g = groundSampleAt([x, 0, z]); return g ? isOutdoorWaterTile(g.tile) || (feetWaterCoverage(g.tile, g.feet) ?? 0) >= SWIM_COVERAGE : null; }, compensation: () => modeNow() === 'dungeon' ? [0, 0, 0] : state.compensation, renderer: () => renderer, feet: () => (walkMode ? player.pos : null), mode: modeNow, foes: () => (modeNow() === 'exterior' ? exteriorFoePool() : modes?.insideFoes?.() ?? []), paused: gamePaused, overlay: () => !!townTalk.overlayActive || !!modes?.topWindow?.(), topWindow: () => modes?.topWindow?.() ?? townTalk.overlay, townMapOrigin: () => { const px = playerTravelPixel(), b = built.get(`${px.x},${px.y}`), t = state.pixelTranslation(px.x, px.y); return b?.locOrigin ? b.locOrigin.map((v, i) => v + t[i]) : null; }, collider: () => player.collider, dungeon: () => modes?.dungeonCtx, exterior: () => ({ doors: buildingDoors.map(shiftedDoor), people: _livePersons, pixels: built.values(), pixelTranslation: (px, py) => state.pixelTranslation(px, py), loot: droppedLoot.lootTargets(), corpses: [...cityGuards.lootTargets(), ...exteriorFoes.lootTargets()] }), interior: () => modes?.interiorCtx, interiorBuildingType: () => modes?.interiorBuilding?.buildingType, interiorRecords: () => !!seatHere(modes?.interiorBuilding?.townMapId || (_questLoc()?.mapTableData?.mapId ?? 0)), climbing: () => !!(player.climb?.isClimbing || player.mantling || player.onWall), weapon: () => weaponRig.playerWeapon, hooks: inputHooks })).catch((err) => console.error('[agent] the bridge could not load:', err?.message ?? err));
